The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

To explain the complex concept of blockchain using an analogy: Imagine a community notebook where everyone writes down every transaction that happens in their village. Instead of keeping this notebook in one person's house (which could be lost, burned, or tampered with), every single villager keeps an identical copy of the notebook. When a new transaction occurs, it is broadcast to everyone. The villagers then check their own notebooks to verify the transaction is valid. Once the majority agrees it is correct, the new entry is added to everyone's notebook at the same time. Because everyone has a copy, no single person can secretly change a past entry without everyone else noticing, making the record extremely secure and trustworthy.
